SELECT wt.worker_id AS workerId, w.worker_no AS workerNo, w.name AS name, wt.check_in AS checkIn,
CASE WHEN bt.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS onBreak
FROM work_time wt
INNER JOIN worker w ON wt.worker_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN break_time bt ON wt.id = bt.work_time_id AND bt.break_end IS NULL
WHERE wt.check_date = CURDATE() AND wt.check_in IS NOT NULL AND wt.check_out IS NULL
ORDER BY wt.check_in
